statement.base: I move between research, interface and code without ever really leaving one for the other —
statement.mid1: that hold up under real use,
statement.suffix: that make them a little smarter.

featuredWork.title: Two ways of solving the same problem.
featuredWork.description: One built around a person and a screen. One built around a model and a conversation.

steps.title: Research
steps.description: Understand the person before the pixel — interviews, empathy maps, the real shape of the problem.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Wireframes become interfaces, interfaces become systems, systems become something someone can trust.

steps.title: Build & Ship
steps.description: React on the frontend, AI where it earns its place — shipped, measured, and iterated on.
